description: Project scaffolding with Vite + React + Three.js + TypeScript + Vitest. Sets up the complete development environment and build pipeline.
steps: Initialize a new Vite project with React and TypeScript template in /projects/sandbox/pvz (overwriting existing files as needed). Use: npm create vite@latest . -- --template react-ts
Install core dependencies: react, react-dom, three, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, zustand
Configure vitest.config.ts (or add test config in vite.config.ts) with jsdom environment
Configure tsconfig.json with strict mode, path aliases if helpful
Create src/main.tsx entry point rendering App component
Create src/App.tsx with a basic @react-three/fiber Canvas that renders a simple colored box as a smoke test
Add npm scripts: dev, build, test, preview
Run npm run build to verify the project compiles successfully
Run npm run test to verify vitest is configured (can be a trivial passing test in src/__tests__/setup.test.ts)
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without errors
npm run test runs and passes with at least one trivial test
npx tsc --noEmit passes with no TypeScript errors
The project structure has src/App.tsx with a Canvas component from @react-three/fiber
